_note: Starter reference list. Meanings cross-checked on 2026-10-06 against adinkrasymbols.org (a secondary, commercial website, not a native-speaker or scholarly review): all 13 names/meanings agree in substance. Still verified=false until a cultural adviser reviews. Known wording differences: Akoma (site: love, faithfulness), Aya (site: endurance, perseverance), Nkyinkyim (site: toughness, versatility, dynamism). Sankofa has two forms: the bird looking back with an egg, and the stylised heart. Do not add entries without a source.
